name: Dirty-worktree recovery
description: Recover a dirty worktree without losing useful changes, overwriting another lane, or claiming cleanliness before evidence exists.

outcomes.description: Useful changes and untracked decisions are preserved in a named, reviewable rescue state.
The chosen keep, move, or abandon decision ends with an accurately reported worktree state.

prerequisites.description: Current branch, changed files, untracked data, and active lane ownership are visible.
prerequisites.check: Capture status and changed-file names before touching the worktree.

prerequisites.description: No rescue step will overwrite another lane or copy secret material into evidence.
prerequisites.check: Compare scopes and mark unknown files for explicit review.

lanes.objective: Inventory branch, changed files, untracked data, ownership, and rescue choices.
Preserve useful changes in a reviewable scoped patch without forceful destruction.
Verify the chosen worktree state, scope ownership, and recoverability after rescue.

qualityGates.description: Every changed and untracked item has a safe owner or explicit rescue decision.
Useful work is retained in the reserved scope and unknown data is not silently removed.
After-state evidence accurately reports clean, still-dirty, or deliberately abandoned worktree status.

ownerConfirmationBoundaries.action: Enter a password, one-time code, passkey, or challenge response while inspecting a worktree.
ownerConfirmationBoundaries.boundary: Stop and hand the entry to the owner; keep rescue evidence local and redacted.
ownerConfirmationBoundaries.reason: Authentication material is a human-only boundary.

ownerConfirmationBoundaries.action: Delete unknown data, change account security or billing, perform destructive data work, or execute live financial behavior.
ownerConfirmationBoundaries.boundary: Stop before the action and obtain one explicit owner confirmation for that individual action.
ownerConfirmationBoundaries.reason: Recovery must preserve uncertainty rather than destroy it.

rollbackRescue.rollbackPlan: Keep the original status inventory and use the preserved patch or last known-good integration point to recover from a mistaken rescue choice.
rescueSteps: Record changed-file names and ownership before editing.
Preserve a redacted patch or explicit abandonment decision.
Recheck status and scope before declaring the worktree clean.
stopConditions: Ownership of a changed file is unclear.
A rescue step would overwrite or remove unknown work.
A protected owner boundary is reached.

redactionRules: Omit credentials, tokens, private paths, and secret file contents.
Record file names only when they are safe to disclose.
